_about: Exclusion log: accounts and products deliberately left out of the Scent Atlas, with the reason, so they aren't re-added by accident.

items.name: sweet_dreamperfumes
items.reason: Sells copies/imitations of major-brand fragrances ('factory-direct, 10,000+ scents'); doesn't fit the Atlas's original-creation focus.

items.name: Fatma Fragrance Oil (fatma_fragranceoil)
items.reason: B2B wholesaler of inspired (copy) oils and private label, MOQ 100 ml; not a consumer perfume house.

items.name: Luxodor (luxodoroil)
items.reason: B2B supplier of Swiss-made fragrance oils to brands (samples, bulk); not a consumer perfume house. Could suit the Global Regional Map as a sourcing lead instead.

items.name: MS Luxury Perfumes 'Parfum Milky' (marouaa_shop)
items.reason: Post is labelled AI content; skipped under the no-AI-content rule.

items.name: Kenzo Parfum d'Été
items.reason: Big designer brand; out of scope.

items.name: Botari (botari.k) hand creams
items.reason: Scented hand creams, not perfume; out of scope.

items.name: Cieal Perfumes (ciealperfumes)
items.reason: Most of its range is sold as 'inspired versions' of designer perfumes (Jean Paul Gaultier, YSL, Burberry, Victoria's Secret). Its solid perfume tins come only in sets of 12 × 10 g (₹890) with no named scents or notes.

items.name: Cloudar (Drake)
items.reason: Celebrity fragrance line, outside the Atlas's small-house focus.

items.name: Big and celebrity launches in the Oct/Nov release lists
items.reason: Valentino, Rabanne, Jo Malone, Paris Hilton, Tate McRae, Dove, eos and Squishmallows: big designer, celebrity or mass brands.

items.name: Seinde Signature
items.reason: A fragrance retailer and perfume bar, not a perfume house. Could return under stores.

items.name: Cececa
items.reason: A scent-marketing firm, not a perfume house.
